units.statement: Pre-existing adaptive immunity to the RNA-editing enzyme RfxCas13d is prevalent in humans, encompassing IgG antibodies detected by ELISA in the majority of donors, antigen-induced CD4 and CD8 T-cell proliferative responses in most tested samples (CD4 in 24/24, CD8 in 23/24), inflammatory cytokine production (IFN-Î³, IL-17, TNF-Î±) by CD4 T cells in 21/24 (88%) samples, and CD8 cytotoxic potential evidenced by CD107a upregulation in 12/15 (80%) samples â with the overall prevalence and magnitude comparable to that observed for SpCas9 and SaCas9 controls.
